hotels.description: Nestled within a naturally sheltered cove, Aavya Cove Villas offers an intimate retreat on Sri Lanka's spectacular southwest coast. Villas and suites sit among two acres of lush tropical gardens, flowing seamlessly between private terraces, outdoor rain showers and the open horizon of the Indian Ocean. The chefs at onsite restaurant Tangerine handpick ingredients daily from local fishermen and the property's organic gardens, while the hotel's Aarogya Spa offers Ayurvedic rituals drawn from centuries of wisdom. The sleepy coastal town of Balapitiya invites laidback sightseeing at your own pace. Ancient mangrove forests beg to be explored by boat, a sea turtle conservation centre awaits, and Galle Fort is just a 45-minute drive away. This is Sri Lanka at its most unspoiled - unhurried, abundantly alive and utterly captivating.
